chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAlī ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullah, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Barqī, from his father, from Ḥamzah ibn ʿAbdullāh, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from ʿAlī ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, from whom the author narrates
key_terms.إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ: Ishaq ibn Ammar, a narrator in the chain
key_terms.الْبَرْقِيِّ: al-Barqī, the well-known narrator family name
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ: Ali ibn Abd al-Aziz, the terminal narrator named in this sanad

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from ʿAlī ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance is bibliographical and hadith-related, identifying the exact chain through which the author received these narrations.
